title: French A1: Listening practice, hand-built
topic: French A1 listening: hear a phrase, pick what you heard, then say it back
description: A tiny companion to the French A1 course: two listening exercises written by hand in the course builder, one where you pick the sentence you heard and one where you repeat it. Every item here was built with the builder's Listen and choose and Listen and repeat forms.
author: Well of Wisdom example pack

lessons.title: Hear it, pick it
lessons.summary: One sentence is spoken. Choose the words you heard.

content.prompt: Qu'entends-tu ? Pick the sentence you heard.
content.audioText: Je veux du pain, s'il vous plait.

choices.text: Je veux du pain, s'il vous plait.
Je veux du the, s'il vous plait.
Je veux dormir, s'il vous plait.

content.explanation: Pain means bread. The is tea, and dormir is to sleep.
hints: Listen for the food word: it comes right after je veux.

content.prompt: Qu'entends-tu ? Pick the sentence you heard.
content.explanation: Maison is house and bleue is blue (feminine).

lessons.title: Hear it, say it
lessons.summary: Listen, then repeat the phrase out loud.

content.prompt: Listen and repeat: Le livre est rouge.
content.explanation: Livre is book and rouge is red. The expected text shows after you answer.
hints: Say each word clearly: le, livre, est, rouge.

content.prompt: Listen and repeat: Bonjour, comment ca va ?
hints: It is a greeting plus a question. Take them one at a time.
